name: Merged cells (multirow / multicolumn)
description: Cells spanning several rows or columns, with a partial rule under a grouped header.
notes: `\multicolumn{n}{c}{text}` spans *n* columns. It's built in, no package needed.
`\multirow{n}{*}{text}` spans *n* rows. Leave the cells below it empty.
`\cmidrule(l){3-4}` draws a rule under columns 3–4; `(l)`/`(r)` trim its ends so neighbouring rules don't touch.
